value.rationale: A complete integral homotopy filtration and barcode for the canonical symmetric 16-vertex Möbius–Kantor graph is a natural previously undetermined invariant. Its first nontrivial graph-power Rips stage has both 2- and 3-sphere summands outside existing high-girth and edge-disjoint-hexagon family theorems; the exact full classification is a useful finite benchmark, not a routine numerical count.
